name: Default piorx workflow
description: Sample fixture exercising the WorkflowSpecV1 structural validator.
goals: Capture user intent verbatim and produce a canonical restatement
Build evidence narrowly from retriever-authored defaults
Synthesize either an analysis report or an executable change spec

stages.name: Stage 1 — Restatement
stages.description: Capture intent and produce a user-approved restatement.

stages.name: Stage 5 — Synthesis
stages.description: Produce an analysis-report or change-spec artifact from the evidence bundle.

control.acceptance_criteria: Output validates structurally AND contains at least one actionable element

stages.name: Stage 6 — Execution
stages.description: Apply changes from the change-spec to the repository.

edges.description: Restatement directly feeds synthesis in this minimal fixture.
